visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a dark beard and black cap worn backward is juggling a silver metallic bottle and its black cap. He wears a brown short-sleeved jumpsuit with white embroidery on the left chest. The background is a composite of a scenic mountain lake under a bright, clear sky. (2) The scene cuts to the man in a campsite setting with a yellow tent and mountains. He holds the silver bottle vertically while looking at the camera. (3) A fast montage shows an underwater torpedo, a 3D medical animation of a heart with a stent, and a water bottle, illustrating the use of titanium. (4) The man stands against a grey studio wall with dark diagonal stripes. He tosses the bottle and speaks with animated hand gestures. (5) Against a background of a coffee cup with foam, he holds the bottle while text overlays appear beside him. (6) A close-up shows an industrial drill bit carving into a silver metal part held in a vice. (7) The man appears in front of an explosion/fire graphic, looking frustrated while trying to screw a bottle cap on manually. (8) He demonstrates a new bottle cap mechanism, snapping it off and on with one hand against a silver tinsel curtain. (9) A close-up POV shot looks inside the bottle showing an engraved 'Ti' logo on the bottom. (10) Metal tongs are seen vigorously scraping the interior walls of the bottle. (11) The man stands outdoors on a city street with traffic and buildings, swinging the bottle by its cap loop in a martial arts-style spin. (12) He ends the video against a plain grey background, speaking directly to the camera with a serious but friendly expression.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Educational Context -> Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Feature Demonstration -> Humorous Outro -> Disclaimer.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'VERVE 零秒瓶' (Zero-Second Bottle), a titanium thermos with a unique easy-open cap. It starts by educating the audience on the premium qualities of titanium to justify the product's value, then highlights common frustrations with traditional screw-on caps before demonstrating the ease and durability of the advertised product through high-energy visuals and humor.
